workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, I've checked Priya and Marcus's calendars. Their overlapping free slots for a 30-min meeting are: Mon 9:00-10:00, Tue 10:30-11:00, Tue 13:00-14:00, Tue 16:30-17:00, Wed 15:00-16:00, Thu 10:00-10:30, Fri 11:00-12:00. Please check Elena and David's calendars against these and let me know the earliest slot that works for all four. Thanks!

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

- Mon 9:00-10:00: Elena busy 9:00-10:00
- Tue 10:30-11:00: Elena busy 10:30-11:00
- Tue 13:00-14:00: Both Elena and David busy this entire period
- Tue 16:30-17:00: Elena busy 16:30-17:00
- Wed 15:00-16:00: Both Elena and David busy
- Thu 10:00-10:30: Elena busy 10:00-10:30
- Fri 11:00-12:00: Both Elena and David busy

Here are the times when BOTH Elena and David are free next week:
- Mon 11:00-12:00
- Tue 9:00-10:00
- Wed 13:00-14:00
- Thu 9:30-10:00
- Thu 14:30-15:30
- Fri 15:00-16:00

Can you check which of these slots work for Priya and Marcus? The earliest option would be Mon 11:00-11:30 or Mon 11:30-12:00.
